title: Add local Human Review CSV downloads to Extension options
approved_decision: Reuse the existing read-only M4-FU02 CSV exporter behind an exact-origin localhost download endpoint and two Extension options controls.
scope: download canonical root review CSV from Extension options
download Thread Sequence review CSV from Extension options
apply the currently selected collected-root status filter
reuse the existing CSV row builders and UTF-8 BOM renderer
preserve read-only database and analysis-only source boundaries
forbidden: duplicating CSV generation in the Extension
committing live CSV or source text
exposing exports outside loopback and the exact Extension origin
exposing review data through Generation-facing DTOs
